policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O announces presence product
items.summary: O published an announcement introducing its “Presence” product, signaling a new customer-facing capability beyond core ChatGPT usage. Likely incremental, but relevant for enterprise rollout and feature expansion.

items.headline: O partners disclose eval security incident
items.summary: O described a security incident during model evaluation with Hugging Face, attributing it to specific internal models used for cyber-capability benchmarking. Impacts trust/governance posture more than revenue near-term.

items.headline: O releases GPT-5.6 + ChatGPT Work
items.summary: Axios reported O shipped GPT-5.6 plus a ChatGPT Work tool, after governmental engagement around rollout timing. This is a major product-cycle signal that can drive adoption and compute demand.
